findings.body: The previous finding remains open. When a successful initial answer asks a question and leaves uncommitted changes, a failed commit nudge can prevent `_question` from running. Both Claude paths leave `outcome` as `failed` if the nudge raises (lines 188–196), and Codex changes it to `failed` when the nudge returns an unsuccessful status (lines 212–213). The initial question then receives neither a pending record nor an occurrence id. Subsequent work can proceed unanswered, and close.py:63–65 blocks only persisted questions. The nudge tests still cover successful nudges only. Preserve questions from successful answers independently of the nudge's outcome.
findings.title: Preserve pending questions when a commit nudge fails
